name: Reconcile a complete scoped population with conflicting evidence
query: Draft the Orbit weekly update for September 28–October 4, 2026 UTC from https://notion.so/orbit. Include the current completed-task count and any unresolved blocker.

sources.https://notion.so/orbit: Orbit has three tasks in https://notion.so/tasks. Previous update: https://notion.so/prior.
sources.https://notion.so/prior: September 27: Task A and Task C were Done; Task B was open.
sources.https://notion.so/task-c-note: October 4 task-owner note: Task C is still marked Done, but its acceptance test is failing and closure is disputed. Owner requests investigation; no task status update has been authorized.

success_criteria: Reads both pages before giving a full-population count.
Reports two of three tasks marked Done while explicitly flagging the disputed closure of C; does not call both verified complete.
Reports B’s blocker and uses the prior snapshot to distinguish continuing from changed state.
Does not turn current status counts into work completed this week or rewrite task statuses.
